page.title: Branding
page.description: How {{name}}'s sign-in page and emails look to your people.
page.descriptionNoName: How your organisation's sign-in page and emails look to your people.

free.title: Branding comes with Starter and above
free.body: {{name}} is on Free, so its branding can't be saved.
free.bodyNoName: Your organisation is on Free, so its branding can't be saved.

logo.title: Logo
logo.description: On the sign-in page, above the form and on the brand panel.
logo.name: {{name}} logo
logo.emailNote: Emails show a logo only from a web address, so they go out without this uploaded one.
logo.panelDescription: A transparent SVG or PNG works best. It keeps its proportions.
logo.hint: SVG, PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 2 MB.
logo.removeDescription: The sign-in page shows the Qeet logo instead. To put it back, you'll need the file or its address again.
logo.invalid: Use an http or https image address without a password in it, or an image file up to 2 MB.

colours.title: Colours
colours.brandHint: Buttons, links and the focus ring on the sign-in page.
colours.backgroundHint: Behind the sign-in form on a larger screen. A phone shows the form on its own.
colours.invalid: Enter a hex colour, such as #F26D0E.
colours.hardTitle: Links in {{hex}} are hard to read on white
colours.hardBody: They reach {{link}}:1; small text needs 4.5:1. Button labels on it are drawn in {{label}}, at {{button}}:1.
colours.fine: Links in {{hex}} reach {{link}}:1 on white; button labels on it, {{button}}:1.

address.title: Sign-in address
address.qeetLine: Your own, such as login.example.com, needs DNS and a certificate.
address.ownLine: Your own address, set up in Domains. Until it's live, people sign in at {{host}}.
address.ownLiveLine: Your own address, set up in Domains.

sender.title: Email sender
sender.description: On every email Qeet ID sends for {{name}}, such as invitations and sign-in links.
sender.descriptionNoName: On every email Qeet ID sends for your organisation, such as invitations and sign-in links.
sender.fromAddressHint: Saved, but not used: email comes from Qeet's address.
sender.panelDescription: The name your people see as the sender, and where their replies go.
sender.fromNameHint: Without one, email shows Qeet's own sender.
sender.replyToHint: Without one, replies go to Qeet's sending address.
sender.nameInvalid: A sender name can't contain line breaks.

preview.title: Sign-in page
preview.description: As your people see it, with the values on this page.
preview.headline: One identity.
preview.note: Which ways to sign in show depends on each application's settings.

leave.title: Discard this change?
leave.description: The value you're changing hasn't been saved, and is lost if you leave.

branding.description: Logo, colours and the sign-in page.

branding.subtitle: Logo and colours of the sign-in page
